attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: যে শাসনে শাসকের ক্ষমতা প্রায় অসীম।

definition.oewn_definition: characteristic of an absolute ruler or absolute rule; having absolute sovereignty
definition.text: characteristic of an absolute ruler or absolute rule; having absolute sovereignty

examples.en: The novel is set under an autocratic regime.

bangla_explanation.text: অন্যের কথা না শুনে নিজের ইচ্ছে চাপিয়ে দেওয়া।

definition.oewn_definition: offensively self-assured or given to exercising usually unwarranted power
definition.text: offensively self-assured or given to exercising usually unwarranted power

examples.bn: স্বেচ্ছাচারী অধিনায়ক দলের পরিকল্পনা উপেক্ষা করল।
examples.en: An autocratic captain ignored the team's plan.
